# Forge Cache Extension

## Purpose

A key-value cache registered in the Forge container: per-key TTLs, a default expiry, key
prefixes, glob-style key lookup and size limits. Values are `[]byte`.

Only the in-memory driver works today. `redis` and `memcached` pass config validation but service
construction fails (see "Not implemented yet").

Module: github.com/xraph/forge/extensions/cache (package `cache`). This extension is the
reference shape for Forge extensions: `*forge.BaseExtension` embedded, functional options over
`DefaultConfig()`, `LoadConfig` in Register, a constructor registered through vessel.

## Constructors and options

```go
func NewExtension(opts ...ConfigOption) forge.Extension
func NewExtensionWithConfig(config Config) forge.Extension   // same as NewExtension(WithConfig(cfg))
func DefaultConfig() Config

type ConfigOption func(*Config)
WithDriver(driver string)           // "inmemory", "redis", "memcached"
WithURL(url string)                 // required by validation for redis and memcached
WithDefaultTTL(ttl time.Duration)
WithMaxSize(size int)
WithPrefix(prefix string)
WithConnectionPoolSize(size int)
WithRequireConfig(require bool)
WithConfig(config Config)
```

Lower level: `NewCacheService(config Config, logger forge.Logger, metrics forge.Metrics) (*CacheService, error)`,
`NewInMemoryCache(config Config, logger forge.Logger, metrics forge.Metrics) *InMemoryCache`.

## What the container holds

`*cache.CacheService` by type and under the alias `cache` (ServiceKey), and the `cache.Cache`
interface backed by the same singleton. The service connects on start and disconnects on stop.

```go
c, err := cache.GetCache(app.Container())      // also MustGetCache, GetCacheFromApp, MustGetCacheFromApp
c, err = forge.Inject[cache.Cache](app.Container())

// or take it as a constructor parameter
func NewUserService(c cache.Cache) *UserService { ... }
_ = forge.Provide(app.Container(), NewUserService)
```

`(*CacheService).Cache() Cache` returns the backend itself, which you need for the typed helpers.

## Key types

```go
type Cache interface {
    Connect(ctx context.Context) error
    Disconnect(ctx context.Context) error
    Ping(ctx context.Context) error                                       // ErrNotConnected until started
    Get(ctx context.Context, key string) ([]byte, error)                  // ErrNotFound if missing or expired
    Set(ctx context.Context, key string, value []byte, ttl time.Duration) error  // ttl 0 = DefaultTTL
    Delete(ctx context.Context, key string) error                         // missing key is not an error
    Exists(ctx context.Context, key string) (bool, error)
    Clear(ctx context.Context) error
    Keys(ctx context.Context, pattern string) ([]string, error)           // one "*" wildcard
    TTL(ctx context.Context, key string) (time.Duration, error)           // 0 = never expires
    Expire(ctx context.Context, key string, ttl time.Duration) error      // ttl <= 0 = permanent
}

type StringCache interface { GetString(...); SetString(...) }               // in-memory implements
type JSONCache interface {                                                  // in-memory implements
    GetJSON(ctx context.Context, key string, target any) error
    SetJSON(ctx context.Context, key string, value any, ttl time.Duration) error
}
type CounterCache interface { Incr, IncrBy, Decr, DecrBy }                  // no backend implements
type MultiCache interface { MGet, MSet, MDelete }                           // no backend implements
```

Typed helpers through the backend:

```go
svc, err := forge.Inject[*cache.CacheService](app.Container())
jc, ok := svc.Cache().(cache.JSONCache)
```

Errors: ErrNotFound, ErrNotConnected, ErrInvalidTTL (negative DefaultTTL), ErrKeyTooLarge,
ErrValueTooLarge, ErrUnsupportedOperation. An empty key on Set returns a plain error.

## In-memory behaviour

- A map behind a sync.RWMutex, with a sweep every CleanupInterval that drops expired entries.
- Prefix is added on write and stripped from Keys results.
- At MaxSize, the next Set evicts one entry: an expired one if found, else an arbitrary one in
  Go map order. Not LRU.
- Keys walks every entry under the read lock; keep it off hot paths. A pattern with two `*`
  matches nothing.
- Metrics: hit, miss, set, delete, clear and eviction counters through Forge metrics.

## Config

Key `extensions.cache`, falling back to `cache`. File overrides defaults, options override the file.
Keys are snake_case. The old Go field names (`MaxSize`) still apply and log a deprecation
warning naming the new key; when both are set the snake_case one wins.

| Key | Default |
| --- | --- |
| driver | "inmemory" |
| url | "" |
| default_ttl | 5m |
| max_size | 10000 (0 = no limit) |
| cleanup_interval | 1m |
| max_key_size | 250 bytes (0 = no limit) |
| max_value_size | 1048576 bytes (0 = no limit) |
| prefix | "" |
| connection_pool_size | 10 (network drivers only) |
| connection_timeout, read_timeout, write_timeout | 5s, 3s, 3s (network drivers only) |

```yaml
extensions:
  cache:
    driver: inmemory
    default_ttl: 10m
    max_size: 50000
    prefix: "orders:"
```

Forge only reads config.yaml when `EnableConfigAutoDiscovery` is on.

## Not implemented yet

- `redis` and `memcached`: construction fails with "redis driver not yet implemented" /
  "memcached driver not yet implemented", so the app fails to start. The cache is per process.
- CounterCache and MultiCache are declared but no backend implements them.
